title: Hatsune Miku — Featuring Hello Kitty〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI is much larger than I expected. I discover something new here every day. It's so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Yes, it is! Everyone's found their own favorite spots too, and it seems like they're having a great time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku! Kitty! Would you like to ride the boat with us?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Boat?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Yeah! It's a ride here that looks just like the Sanrio Character Boat Ride from Puroland!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That sounds like fun. I'd love to ride with you!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Hehe, yes! Let's all ride together♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, Pochacco. Where are you off to?

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: That bridge over there! Miku and the others are gonna go on the boat ride, so I'm gonna go over there and wave to them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That sounds like fun! What do you two think, shall we join him?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Oh KAITO, I could never say no to you!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hmmm, I think I would rather go on the boat ride...

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Kuromi...?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Nope! I'm goin' with KAITO and that's that.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, care to ride with us, My Mel?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, thank you♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, does the boat only circle the area around the Wisdom Tree?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Teehee. I think it'll surprise you♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Surprise me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wonder what that could mean. I'm excit—

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Hello Kitty's Voices
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Len & Pompompurin's Voices
rows.Line: Woohoo! Ahaha!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: I-I changed my mind. I want to go to the bridge with Kuromi instead...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Huuuh? It'll be okay♪ We'll all be together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can ride holding hands, if you like. Then you won't have to be afraid.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: R-Really? Do you promise you won't let go until we get off?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course, we promise.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Welcome back! How was the boat ride?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was really cool seeing all the different sights with everyone! And I loved the part where it slid down that slope like “whoosh”!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Yeah! But the drop was scarier than the one in Puroland. It really surprised me.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: I thought I was going to go flying...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: It was great! My ears went swish, flop, flop in the breeze♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way, there was a white house I saw from the boat. What is that?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: It's Puroland's number-one hot spot! Right, Kitty?

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Hehe. That's my home, Lady Kitty House. It has a rose garden and a dress tower. It's totally cute and chic!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A rose garden and a dress tower? That sounds so stylish!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
Riiight? And it— *Gasp*
Nooo!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Wah! That scared me!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: What's wrong, Kuromi? Did you forget something on the boat?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: I didn't go on the boat! It's not that!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Lady Kitty House is filled with a bunch of super cute stuff and I completely forgot to tell Ena and the others about it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Ena?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: I was hangin' in my favorite spot when I ran into her and her friends. They just appeared all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Oh! When I was exploring, I ran into a girl named Saki and her friends, and we became best buds!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Me too! Me too! I made friends with a boy called Toya and his team, and showed them my secret flower field!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?! Could they be the ones who formed this SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems so. Did you meet someone too, Cinnamon?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Oh, I met Emu and her friends! We hung out together all day♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Airi and her friends helped me bake cookies!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: We made enough to share with everyone, so there's plenty left. Do you want some?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hurray♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So you all met them in this SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Wait, do you guys know them too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. We watch over them so they can find their true feelings and work hard to follow their dreams.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Watch over them...

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Oh! Toya said he and his team are working hard to surpass this legendary night!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Emu said she and her troupe want to make tons of people smile with their shows♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: At first, we didn't know how things would turn out for them. Everyone had forgotten their true feelings, or buried them deep down.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was very difficult at the time, but I'm so glad they rediscovered their feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! And those feelings gave birth to songs.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Wooow! I wonder what kind of songs. They must be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? You don't seem very surprised to hear that feelings can give birth to songs.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: That's right. I can kind of understand that.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: After all, I sing songs to tell everyone “You can do it!” and “It will be okay!”

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Teehee. Songs help you say things that are hard to put to words♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're precious because they let people express their emotions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Kitty! I'd love to go see Lady Kitty House if that's okay?

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Yes, of course! I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: I wonder if it will be different than the one in Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: I'll come with! I haven't explored over there yet.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Oh yeah! In Puroland, that area's where we keep the eco-friendly My Melocars I came up with! I wonder if they're here too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Eco-friendly My Melocar? I want to ride that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! I want to ride too, but I also want to see the fancy house!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Then let's do both!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Yup yup♪ The more fun the better!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Hehe, let's have another day filled with fun everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!
